state:
Goal `core-request-mount-and-1-more`: `Core\Request\Mount::captures` and `Core\Request\Mount::prefix` have every proof on disk. That means a description, three examples each, an attack each, a bench each at 0 allocations, a `covers:` marker on the existing Rust test and `.nvst` case, and the `Core\Request\Mount` class card.
The prefix attack carries `// proof: gap nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops`. A loop whose only work is `$b = $b . $b` never stops at the memory limit. The record says what was read and what was not checked.
`Core\Request\Part::content` is the one item left in this goal.
